lines.zh: 骨头敲着黑砖，一路回响。
lines.en: Bones tap black brick, echoing down the hall.

lines.zh: 要塞的走廊，我走了几百年。
lines.en: I've walked these fortress halls for centuries.
My stone sword drags, throwing sparks.
Out of the way; I still have towers to patrol.
Every step, my ribs rattle.

lines.zh: 下界的风把灰吹进我眼眶。
lines.en: Nether wind blows ash into my sockets.

lines.zh: 我沿着栏杆走，从不看下面。
lines.en: I walk the railing and never look down.
My steps are light because I have no flesh.

lines.zh: 熔岩在下面翻滚，正好照路。
lines.en: Lava churns below and lights my path.
This floor is mine; don't wander.
I count the stairs, one by one.
No heartbeat, yet my stride is steady.

lines.zh: 我记不清这是谁的骨头。
lines.en: I can't recall whose bones these were.
The skulls in the corner are all empty.
The wall is creaking. Not me.

lines.zh: 凋零在我骨缝里慢慢长。
lines.en: Withering grows slowly in my joints.
Nobody ever lights the fortress lamps.

lines.zh: 我等着一个能打的对手。
lines.en: I wait for an opponent worth the swing.

lines.zh: 这把剑比我的手臂还旧。
lines.en: This sword is older than my arm.
Wind through my ribs sounds like a flute.
Footsteps, and they aren't mine.
Quiet enough to hear the ash settle.
Your flesh looks warm.
I haven't seen a living one in ages.
Your gaze is trembling.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，因为你在呼吸。
lines.en: I stare because you're breathing.
Looking for a way out? So am I.
Don't back away; I haven't seen enough.
New armor. What a waste.
I'm counting how often you blink.
You smell of burnt torch.
Seen enough; time to move.
A cracked bone is nothing.
That pain, I forgot long ago.
My arm is still half attached.
You've cut through my patience.
Don't celebrate; I can still rise.
Bone dust everywhere. A shame.
I'll carve this cut into my blade.
Pain belongs to the living.

lines.zh: 退后，我要捡回那根骨头。
lines.en: Step back; I need that bone back.

lines.zh: 你让我想起了活着的时候。
lines.en: You remind me of being alive.
Food? I don't even have a stomach.

lines.zh: 别拿肉来，那味道让我恶心。
lines.en: No meat; the smell disgusts me.
Gold? The Nether is full of it.
You want to feed a pile of bones?

lines.zh: 收起来，我只对头颅感兴趣。
lines.en: Put it away; only skulls interest me.
Bone for bone is a poor trade.
I'm not hungry, just never sleepy.

lines.zh: 你的面包在发霉，我闻得到。
lines.en: Your bread is molding. I can smell it.
Temptation does nothing to the dead.

lines.zh: 拿开，别让油滴到我剑上。
lines.en: Move it; don't drip grease on my sword.

lines.zh: 撞散了骨头，你得帮我捡。
lines.en: You scattered my bones; help me gather them.
Careful; my hand might come off.
That much force won't move the dead.
Touch me and your neck goes cold.
Step back; the blade has no eyes.
My shoulder blade is grinding.
One more shove and I draw.
Your body heat unsettles me.

lines.zh: 走廊这么窄，你偏要凑过来。
lines.en: The hall is narrow, yet you crowd me.
Watch your step; that's my foot bone.

lines.zh: 亡灵没有后代，只有替身。
lines.en: The undead have no children, only replacements.

lines.zh: 配对？我的伴侣是这把剑。
lines.en: A partner? This sword is my companion.

lines.zh: 别给我说媒，我忘了怎么笑。
lines.en: No matchmaking; I forgot how to smile.
Bone against bone only rattles.

lines.zh: 我等的不是爱人，是对手。
lines.en: I wait for a rival, not a lover.

lines.zh: 婚约写在墓碑上，早磨平了。
lines.en: My vows were carved on a headstone, worn away.

lines.zh: 孤独是亡灵唯一的东西。
lines.en: Loneliness is all the undead keep.

lines.zh: 你要替我介绍一具骷髅？
lines.en: You'd introduce me to a skeleton?
I have no heart, so I can't fancy anyone.
Move; I'm going back to my tower.
This sword will do.
There's coal on the floor. Take it.

lines.zh: 骨头？正好补我缺的那根。
lines.en: A bone? It fills the gap in my ribs.
That dropped bow is too weak for me.

lines.zh: 这顶头盔，塞不进我的头。
lines.en: This helmet won't fit my skull.
It's mine now; keep your hands off.

lines.zh: 我的东西，都从别人手里来。
lines.en: Everything I own came from someone else.
Pick it up and tuck it under my ribs.
I recognize this skull.
Even scrap iron can sharpen a blade.

lines.zh: 活的气味，从走廊那头来。
lines.en: A living scent, from the far end of the hall.
Draw your blade; don't keep me waiting.
You stepped on my stair.

lines.zh: 要塞里不许有第二个人。
lines.en: The fortress allows no second guest.
One look from me and you should run.
The sword is raised; spare the begging.
No withering on you yet. Perfect.
I'll split the shield first, talk later.
Come here; chasing bores me.
My gaze arrives before the blade.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，救不了你。
lines.en: That torch in your hand won't save you.
Target chosen: the end of the corridor.
I can smell your sweat.
Don't shut that door; I can push it open.

lines.zh: 你的脚步撞上要塞的墙，传过来了。
lines.en: Your steps bounce off the fortress walls and reach me.

lines.zh: 石剑拖在地上，火星一路跟着我。
lines.en: My stone sword drags on the floor, sparks trailing behind me.
My blade is three blocks away.
Don't circle the pillar; I know this floor.

lines.zh: 你的盾举得越高，破绽越大。
lines.en: The higher your shield, the wider the gap.

lines.zh: 我的脚步没有声音，别听。
lines.en: My steps make no sound. Don't listen.
Withering bites your hand first.
Another step back is lava.
Have you counted the fortress floors?
I'll let you catch your breath, then strike.
Don't turn; I'm right behind you.

lines.zh: 火光在抖，是因为你手抖。
lines.en: The torchlight shakes because your hands do.
I've sealed this passage many times.
You can't run fast with all those bones.
Quiet; let me hear your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 你把门堵上，我从侧廊绕。
lines.en: You block the door. I take the side passage.

lines.zh: 你在桥中间，两边都是空气。
lines.en: You are mid-bridge. Both sides are air.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在暗里比你的眼亮。
lines.en: My bones shine brighter in the dark than your eyes.

lines.zh: 你退进死角，我就慢下来。
lines.en: You back into a dead end, so I slow down.
The blade falls, and bone remembers.
This strike carries withering.
Your arm is turning black.
Don't block with your hand; that's my sword.
Back off; my swing isn't done.
Splitting a shield feels good.
The second cut is faster than the first.
Kneeling suits you better than standing.
The wound will darken slowly.
Don't shout; nobody's in the fortress.
Bone on iron makes a fine sound.

lines.zh: 这一剑，是替塔里的空位。
lines.en: This one is for the empty tower.
Still on your feet? How interesting.
Fall; the ash will cover you.

lines.zh: 剑锋划开你的袖口，皮先裂。
lines.en: The edge parts your sleeve, then the skin.

lines.zh: 我打你一下，退半步再看。
lines.en: I strike once, step back, and watch.

lines.zh: 下界要塞的暗处，我站着。
lines.en: I stand in the dark of a Nether fortress.
Bones grow out of the brick seams.
Torches don't reach here. Good.
A new body puts on old armor.
I woke with the sword already in hand.
Lava light falls across my face.

lines.zh: 这里太亮了，我往深处走。
lines.en: Too bright here; I'll go deeper.
Another tower guard begins.
The skull is set; time to patrol.
The Nether never runs short of bones.

lines.zh: 谁把我拼起来的？不重要。
lines.en: Who assembled me? It doesn't matter.

lines.zh: 走廊尽头有人，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone's at the hall's end. I hear them.

lines.zh: 黑砖上多了我的脚步声。
lines.en: New footsteps echo on the black brick.
Withering has lit up in my eyes.

lines.zh: 火？下界到处都是，早习惯了。
lines.en: Fire? The Nether is full of it.
A broken leg; I'll pick it up and reattach it.
Water rots bone. Keep it away.
You blew off my ribs. Give them back.
An arrow stuck in my joints. Annoying.
Magic won't burn through bone.
I don't eat; I sharpen.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮了我的脸，谢谢。
lines.en: Lightning lit my face. Thank you.
Even bones vanish in the void.
